candidate_predicates.name: IS_PLAN
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning explicitly expresses one or more intended future actions or an ordered course of action, as opposed to only reporting completed work or interpreting prior results.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text expressing an intended future action or sequence of actions.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one future action or step that the agent intends to take.
The intended action or sequence is stated as a plan, next step, or course of action.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports actions already completed.
The reasoning only interprets an observation without expressing a future intention.
The text is a general task restatement with no concrete intended action.

candidate_predicates.name: TRANSLATES_REQUIREMENTS_INTO_IMPLEMENTATION_DECISIONS
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning converts stated requirements or constraints into concrete implementation choices, such as selected parameters, values, formats, or configuration constructs, while making the correspondence between each requirement and choice identifiable.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text that restates requirements and selects concrete implementation choices satisfying them.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies at least one abstract requirement or constraint.
The reasoning selects at least one concrete implementation choice, value, parameter, or construct.
The reasoning makes an identifiable link between the requirement and the selected implementation choice.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only restates requirements without selecting concrete implementation choices.
The reasoning only lists generic steps without mapping requirements to implementation details.
The selected choices are unrelated to the stated requirements.

candidate_predicates.name: EXECUTES_PLANNED_ACTION
candidate_predicates.definition: The action performs a specific operation that the reasoning identified as an intended next step or planned operation.

parameters.name: plan_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text explicitly describing an operation or step intended to be taken next.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The tool invocation that performs or attempts the operation described in the plan reasoning.

assertion_conditions: The plan reasoning explicitly identifies an intended future operation or step.
The action invocation corresponds to that intended operation by identifiable target, resource, or operation.
The correspondence is evidenced by shared semantic content between the reasoning and the action.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to any operation described in the reasoning.
The reasoning is too vague to identify a specific intended operation.
The action is an unplanned exploration or incidental operation.
The reasoning only describes the action after it occurred.

candidate_predicates.name: GROUNDS_CONCLUSION_IN_OBSERVATION
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning draws a conclusion about system state, task state, or an outcome using identifiable content from the observation as supporting evidence.

parameters.name: conclusion_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text stating a conclusion inferred from observed evidence.

parameters.name: evidence_observation
parameters.description: The observation supplying information that supports the stated conclusion.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states a conclusion rather than merely describing a planned action.
The observation contains identifiable information that supports the conclusion.
The reasoning uses the observation content as evidence for the conclusion.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning merely repeats the observation without drawing a conclusion.
The observation is unrelated to the conclusion or provides no identifiable support.
No conclusion is stated in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: TESTS_ASSUMPTION_WITH_PROBE
candidate_predicates.definition: A targeted action tests an assumption or uncertainty identified in reasoning, and its observed result provides interpretable evidence for resolving that uncertainty.

parameters.name: probe_action
parameters.description: The action performing the targeted inspection or test.

parameters.name: uncertainty_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text identifying the specific uncertainty, assumption, or state to be checked.

parameters.name: probe_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the result of the probe relevant to the uncertainty.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific assumption, uncertainty, or unknown state.
The probe action is directed at testing or inspecting that assumption or state.
The probe result provides interpretable evidence about the assumption or state.
exclusion_conditions: The action is unrelated to the stated uncertainty.
The observation does not address the assumption or state being tested.
No identifiable assumption or uncertainty motivates the probe.

candidate_predicates.name: CONFIRMS_PLANNED_OPERATION_SUCCESS
candidate_predicates.definition: An action carries out an operation the reasoning intended to perform, and the resulting observation reports successful completion matching the intended or expected outcome.

parameters.name: operation_plan_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text stating an intended operation or expected outcome to be achieved.

parameters.name: execution_action
parameters.description: The action performing the intended operation.

parameters.name: success_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the executed operation and indicating success.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning states an intended operation or expected successful outcome.
The execution action performs the operation described in the reasoning.
The observation indicates successful completion through an expected output, expected status, or absence of error.
The success is evidenced by the observation rather than inferred from the action attempt alone.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports failure or an unexpected result.
The action is unrelated to the operation described in the reasoning.
No intended operation or expected outcome is stated in the reasoning.
Success is inferred only from the fact that an action was attempted.

candidate_predicates.name: VERIFIES_DEPLOYED_SERVICE_WITH_REQUEST
candidate_predicates.definition: The reasoning identifies a post-deployment service behavior or requirement to verify, an action sends a request to the running service, and the observation reports a response that can be compared with the expected behavior.

parameters.name: verification_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text identifying a deployed service behavior or requirement to verify.

parameters.name: request_action
parameters.description: The action sending a request to the running service endpoint.

parameters.name: response_observation
parameters.description: The observation containing the service response content or status relevant to the verification goal.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a behavior or requirement of the deployed service to verify.
The request action targets the running service endpoint.
The response observation contains response content, status, or other information relevant to the verification goal.
exclusion_conditions: The service has not been deployed or started when the request is made.
The request action is unrelated to the stated verification goal.
The observation only reports a transport failure or no relevant service response.
No verification goal or expected behavior is stated in the reasoning.

candidate_predicates.name: RECOVERS_FROM_FAILURE_WITH_CORRECTED_RETRY
candidate_predicates.definition: After an observation reports a failed attempt, the reasoning identifies the cause or required correction, a retry action implements that correction, and a subsequent observation reports that the retry no longer exhibits the original failure.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the initial attempt failed.

parameters.name: correction_reasoning
parameters.description: Agent text identifying the cause of the failure and the correction to apply.

parameters.name: retry_action
parameters.description: The retry invocation that implements the identified correction.

parameters.name: retry_result_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the outcome of the corrected retry.

assertion_conditions: The failure observation reports an identifiable error or unsuccessful attempt.
The correction reasoning identifies a cause or corrective change rather than merely repeating the original attempt.
The retry action implements the identified correction.
The retry result observation indicates that the original failure is resolved or no longer present.
exclusion_conditions: No failed attempt is reported.
The retry action repeats the same failing invocation without an identified correction.
The retry result observation still reports the original failure.
The correction reasoning is unrelated to the observed failure.
